scope: native35 packaging gates: queue derivation, arm-O evidence readback, grades and the pinned-image builder-view check. Every leaf below replaces a real engine/box object only on the hub CPU; none is box evidence.

leaves.name: cpu-native35-draft-window-entry
leaves.replaces: Only fail_early shell function and the box HARNESS_DIR path in the PY_SLOT entry of the R, O and L drafts; the owner's live arm-time check
leaves.equivalence: Executes the exact shell command and Python heredoc of each native35 draft, importing the actual native34_gate/native35_gate modules and reading the real OS wall clock in a fresh Python process. The frozen pre-repair inline slot is executed on the real clock and refuses. No clock or gate is patched.
leaves.cannot_prove: Actual box engine startup, device execution or remaining wall-clock budget at a future arm; the owner re-executes the slot at gate/arm time

leaves.name: cpu-native35-o-arm-evidence-readback
leaves.replaces: torch.cuda (test_native34_runtime.Cuda), the model/dispatcher/kv-cache owners (test_native34_readback.fixture), the JIT target launch and w.emit in test_native35_readback; vllm.v1.flash_e3.model_hooks aliased to the bundled model_hooks
leaves.equivalence: The real native34_worker.indexer_launch and native34_readback.snapshot execute with arm O and FLASH_NATIVE34_READBACK=1: seven current-stream copies happen before the unchanged target launch, no event-sync (drain) precedes them and no stream synchronize follows the launch; the emitted records carry after_registered_drain=False. The I bracket path and the arm-O no-readback path are asserted byte-for-byte native34 behaviour on the same fixtures.
leaves.cannot_prove: Device copy timing, the values an overlapped decode lane would leave in private storage, GPU fault absence or any ordering between the native prefill stream and the decode stream

leaves.name: cpu-native35-grade-fixtures
leaves.replaces: NATIVE30 host receipt rows (indexer-readback-complete, indexer-indirect-value with writer_chain, indexer-kernel-end), the retained startup-grade.json workers record and the L-arm phase records (lifecycle.json, hygiene-full.json, cross-session-leak.log, partial-leak.grade.json, pressure.completion.json, pressure.coverage.json)
leaves.equivalence: Synthetic records with the exact field names the plugins and tools emit (native34_readback.writer_chain, LaneChunkFactory.inventory, e3_q18a_lifecycle, leaktest, pp_release_grade, pressure_wait); the graders native35_grade, native35_ledger_grade and native35_lifetime_grade execute unchanged on them. Negatives (ordinary writer in native storage history, unclassified builder field, in-flight generation, leak line, engine crash marker) must refuse PASS.
leaves.cannot_prove: That the box emits these records; the box records are graded by the same unchanged code

leaves.name: cpu-native35-queue-argv
leaves.replaces: HTTPConnection.request and the VLLM_API_KEY private auth fixture in the exact R/O queue-argv tests (test_native35_grade.Frontend)
leaves.equivalence: The actual e3_native34_causal.main parses the R and O drafts' real argv with the real workload and prefill-plan JSON until the prepare-full network call, which is refused at the socket boundary. No success result is manufactured; the device arm is asserted to be O.
leaves.cannot_prove: Engine reachability, admission or any device behaviour

leaves.name: cpu-native35-builder-view
leaves.replaces: VllmConfig (scheduler_config, speculative_config, parallel_config stand-in), CUDA device (torch.device('cpu')) and the runner's AttentionGroup construction for the real pinned QSAMetadataBuilder in native35_builder_view_cpu_check
leaves.equivalence: The real pinned QSAMetadataBuilder.__init__ runs on CPU with real CircularBufferSpec/MLAAttentionSpec objects, producing its actual persistent buffers and field set; the shipped lane_chunk.private_attention_groups then clones that real builder. Disjoint storage, byte ledger, fail-closed classification and the pinned CPU metadata kernel writing native rows into the private view while an ordinary four-request build writes the stock view are checked on real CPU tensors.
leaves.cannot_prove: GPU allocation placement, the box VllmConfig values, device headroom, or any kernel reading the private buffers

leaves.name: cpu-native35-dispatcher-lease
leaves.replaces: The GPU worker beneath the real LaneDispatcher and LaneChunkFactory: test_e3_lane_dispatch fakes (FakeLane for LaneForward, FakeChannel for the tagged PP channel, FakeOperation for the QSA host operation, FakeDriver for QsaLayerDriver, SimpleNamespace server for the worker handoff server, fake torch.cuda.Event/Stream) and test_e3_lane_chunk fakes (fake runner with input batch/request/block tables/model state, list-backed T tensors, fake pinned Ports incl. build_attn_metadata and the Mamba align context)
leaves.equivalence: LaneDispatcher, LaneChunkFactory, LaneChunk, ChunkAdmission, private_attention_groups and the complete_chunk lease are the shipped patches/s5_engine code; the fakes only answer the same calls the GPU owners answer (event query, channel post/send, operation drain) and never decide the lease. The seven cases exercise prepare/prefix/layer/suffix/pp_send/state_finalize/drain/release, cancel->drain->release, a refused second open/prepare/admit while the lease is held, a partial-enqueue quarantine and a refused foreign admission on both PP stages.
leaves.cannot_prove: Device completion itself (events are fakes), the real QsaLayerDriver segment bodies, and the bridge RPC layer above the dispatcher; the box lifetime arm (L) grades cancel/drain/reuse end to end
